item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Brazil
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇧🇷 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Brazil Mauro Vieira held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. In a traditionally constructive atmosphere of trust, the Ministers held an in-depth discussion to coordinate positions on key international issues , including in light of the outcomes of the #BRICS Summit held in New Delhi on September 12-13. They had a thorough discussion the current state and prospects of bilateral cooperation , including the schedule of planned contacts. Mauro Vieira outlined preparations for Brazil’s upcoming general elections. The Ministers stressed the imperative of ensuring the free expression of the people’s will without external interference in internal affairs . 🤝 They also noted that Russia and Brazil, both countries with centuries-old historical traditions, share a commitment to treating history with care and rejecting arbitrary interpretations of it . #RussiaBrazil

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Cuba Bruno Rodriguez
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇨🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Foreign Minister of Cuba Bruno Rodriguez held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . In their traditionally open and trusting manner, the Ministers held a constructive exchange of views on current issues of bilateral cooperation , discussed selected regional matters and a greed to further coordinate their positions in international forums , above all at the UN. Sergey Lavrov reaffirmed Russia’s unwavering support for Havana’s just demand for an immediate and complete end to the US trade, economic, financial and, more recently, energy blockade . He stressed the need to remove Cuba , a friend of Russia, from the notorious US list of so-called state sponsors of terrorism and condemned the extraterritorial nature of the unilateral restrictive measures imposed on the Island of Freedom. The Ministers reaffirmed their commitment to continued dialogue and cooperation to strengthen the Russia-Cuba strategic partnership , promote global and regional security, and build a more just #MultipolarWorld order based on respect for the sovereignty of states and their right to choose their own development paths. #RussiaCuba

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Algeria’s Minister of State, Minister of Foreign Affairs, National Community Abroad and African Affairs
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇩🇿 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Algeria’s Minister of State, Minister of Foreign Affairs, National Community Abroad and African Affairs Ahmed Attaf held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Ministers had a thorough discussion of practical steps to further strengthen the enhanced strategic partnership between Russia and Algeria , including the schedule of upcoming contacts at various levels. They expressed satisfaction with the spirit of trust in their political dialogue and their well-established cooperation , both bilaterally and in multilateral forums. 🤝 Following an exchange of views on current regional issues, the Ministers reaffirmed their shared interest in continuing effective coordination to resolve ongoing conflicts through political and diplomatic means , based on the universally recognised principles of international law and the UN Charter . #RussiaAlgeria

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs of Trinidad and Tobago Sean Sobers
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇹🇹 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign and CARICOM Affairs of Trinidad and Tobago Sean Sobers held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . The Ministers exchanged views on key global issues and ways to expand bilateral cooperation in areas of mutual interest , as well as cooperation at the UN and within the Gas Exporting Countries Forum . Following Trinidad and Tobago’s election as a non-permanent member of the UN Security Council for 2027-2028 , the Russian Side expressed its readiness for productive dialogue aimed at finding collective responses to threats to international peace and security. #RussiaTrinidadAndTobago

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Prime Minister of Lebanon Nawaf Salam
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇱🇧 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Prime Minister of Lebanon Nawaf Salam held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly . They held an engaged exchange of views on developments in the Middle East , focusing on the situation in and around Lebanon. The Russian Side reaffirmed its principled support for the unity, territorial integrity and sovereignty of this friendly country . The Sides stressed the need to end hostilities in Lebanon and create conditions for a political and diplomatic settlement of the conflict , in accordance with UN Security Council Resolution 1701 . Particular attention was paid to the possibility of maintaining a UN presence in Lebanon in light of the forthcoming expiry of the mandate of the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon ( #UNIFIL ). 🤝 They also discussed further strengthening traditionally friendly Russia-Lebanon ties , including maintaining regular political dialogue. #RussiaLebanon

item.title: 🇷🇺 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Egyptian Expatriates Badr Abdelatty
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇪🇬 On September 23, Russia’s Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov and Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Egyptian Expatriates Badr Abdelatty held a meeting in New York on the sidelines of the High-Level Week of the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly. The Ministers reviewed key issues of multifaceted Russia-Egypt cooperation , focusing on maintaining the strong momentum of political dialogue, expanding trade and economic cooperation, and implementing major bilateral infrastructure projects. They also discussed preparations for upcoming joint events . They held an in-depth exchange of views on the crisis in the Persian Gulf caused by the unprovoked US and Israeli aggression against Iran . Both Sides stressed the importance of restoring a lasting and sustainable peace in the region through political and diplomatic means . 🤝 The Ministers reaffirmed the need for and continued relevance of close foreign policy coordination between Moscow and Cairo , including at the UN and in other international venues. #RussiaEgypt
